# Index File Formats

> **Scope:** What each index file contains and who maintains it.
> **Load when:** You need to understand or troubleshoot the indexes.
> **See also:** [read-protocol.md](read-protocol.md) | [write-pipeline.md](write-pipeline.md)

---

## Golden Rule

**All index files are generated by `python3 .kb/scripts/index_builder.py`. The AI never writes or edits them.**
The script derives everything from article frontmatter, rewrites a file only when its content changed, and writes atomically (temp file + rename), so indexes never drift and never cost LLM tokens to maintain.

| File | Purpose | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `_master-index.md` | One line per article — the search entry point for broad questions | Agent (Route B) + you |
| `_tools-index.md` | Tool + version → articles | You (browsing), agent for version questions |
| `_ttp-index.md` | MITRE ATT&CK TTP → articles | You (browsing), agent for TTP questions |

---

## 1. `_master-index.md`

Compact on purpose: plain lines (no table overhead), grouped by topic folder, no dates.

```markdown
# Master Index

> Auto-generated by `.kb/scripts/index_builder.py` — do not edit manually. Format: `link | tags | summary`. …

## rasp (2)

- [[wiki/rasp/dexprotector]] | frida, anti-debug, linker | DexProtector 5.x derives its stage-2 key from rtld_db_dlactivity() bytes; Frida's trampoline…
- [[wiki/rasp/r2-pay]] | tracerpid, anti-debug | r2-pay checks TracerPid in /proc/self/status via inline svc calls.
```

- **link:** the article path. Navigation pages (`_index.md`, `_hub.md`) are not listed; hub chunks are.
- **tags:** first 6 `tags` from frontmatter.
- **summary:** `llm_summary`, cut at ~120 characters on a word boundary. Write summaries with the key terms first.
- **topic:** the first folder under `wiki/` (files directly in `wiki/` go under `general`).

---

## 2. `_tools-index.md` and `_ttp-index.md`

```markdown
| Tool | Version | Articles |
|---|---|---|
| Frida | 16.2 | [[wiki/rasp/dexprotector|DexProtector]] |
| IDA Pro | 8.3 | [[wiki/rasp/dexprotector|DexProtector]] |
```

```markdown
| TTP ID | Articles |
|---|---|
| T1629.003 | [[wiki/rasp/dexprotector|DexProtector]] |
```

Built from `tool_versions` and `attack_ttps`. Tool names may have several words; the version is the last word if it starts with a digit (`IDA Pro 8.3` → `IDA Pro` / `8.3`).

---

## 3. Optional Navigation Pages

- **Topic `_index.md`:** optional, hand-written notes for browsing in Obsidian. Not required by compile or search.
- **Hub `_hub.md`:** still used as the entry page for a large multi-part subject (see `write-pipeline.md` §3).

> Older versions generated `_patterns-index.md` and `_snippets-index.md`. The master index replaces both; `index_builder.py` deletes them automatically.

---

## Link Format

- Canonical: `[[wiki/topic/subject]]`, or with an anchor: `[[wiki/topic/subject#anchor|Label]]`.
- Same-directory shorthand: `[[article-name]]` (resolved relative to the linking file's folder).
- The graph visualizer (`knowledge_base/graph/`) is refreshed every time `index_builder.py` runs.
